sourceTitle: At the North of Bearcamp Water Chronicles of a Stroller in New England from July to December
description: "At the North of Bearcamp Water" by Frank Bolles is a collection of nature writings written in the late 19th century. This work chronicles the author's experiences and observations as he strolls through the landscapes of New England from July to December, immersing himself in the beauty, flora, and fauna of the region.
